subtitle.en: Quickly master the use of Scripting app.
subtitle.zh: 快速掌握 Scripting 应用的使用。
功能和 API 更新日志。
subtitle.en: New features and API changes.

Added global ShaderLibrary and Shader, plus the colorEffect, layerEffect, and distortionEffect modifiers. Use built-in tint, variable blur, wave, and displacement effects on iOS 17 or later. On iOS 18 or later, load Mac-compiled Metal libraries using a manifest in your project or at an absolute path. Project shader libraries also load in scripting-ts and saved editor previews.
subtitle.zh: 新增全局 ShaderLibrary 和 Shader，以及 colorEffect、layerEffect 和 distortionEffect 修饰符。iOS 17 或更新版本可使用内置着色、可变模糊、波浪和位移效果。iOS 18 或更新版本可通过项目内或绝对路径指定的清单，加载在 Mac 上预编译的 Metal 库。 项目着色器库也可在 scripting-ts 和编辑器预览中加载。

subtitle.en: Added RealityKit mesh deformation stacks on iOS 27 or later. Apply ordered stages to selected mesh parts and deform vertex positions with CPU offsets or Metal kernels.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 网格变形栈，适用于 iOS 27 或更新版本。可对选定网格部件按顺序应用变形阶段，并使用 CPU 偏移或 Metal 内核修改顶点位置。

subtitle.en: Added RealityKit rigid bodies, collision events, and capsule characters. Create local gravity simulations on iOS 18 or later.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 刚体、碰撞事件和胶囊角色。可在 iOS 18 或更新版本上创建局部重力模拟。

subtitle.en: Added RealityKit physics joints on iOS 18 or later, plus ray and shape casts for collision queries.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 物理关节，适用于 iOS 18 或更新版本，并支持射线和形状扫描来查询碰撞体。

subtitle.en: Added RealityKit particle emitters with built-in presets, custom textures, bursts, and playback controls on iOS 18 or later.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 粒子发射器，支持内置预设、自定义纹理、爆发和播放控制（iOS 18 或更高版本）。

subtitle.en: Added Metal compute for running GPU kernels from Metal source or precompiled libraries, with reusable buffers and byte readback.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Metal 计算，可运行 Metal 源代码或预编译库中的 GPU 内核，并支持复用缓冲区和读回字节。

subtitle.en: Added ordered Metal compute batches to run up to 32 dispatches with one submission.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Metal 批量计算，一次提交按顺序运行最多 32 条调度命令。

subtitle.en: Added shared Metal texture views for compatible Core ML and PixelBuffer storage, including Float16 and BGRA8.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Metal 共享纹理视图，可读取兼容的 Core ML 和 PixelBuffer 存储，支持 Float16 和 BGRA8。

subtitle.en: Added read-only Metal views of BGRA and NV12 camera frames, including both NV12 planes.
subtitle.zh: 新增只读 Metal 相机纹理视图，可读取 BGRA 和 NV12 帧及其两个 NV12 平面。

title.en: Metal GPU Errors and Transfer Limits
title.zh: Metal GPU 错误与传输上限

subtitle.en: Improved Metal GPU error messages and documented transfer limits and foreground execution.
subtitle.zh: 改进 Metal GPU 错误提示，并说明传输上限与前台运行要求。

subtitle.en: Improved Metal buffer uploads from typed arrays.
subtitle.zh: 改进 Metal 缓冲区的 TypedArray 上传速度。

subtitle.en: Improved Metal buffer readback speed and reduced temporary memory use. On iOS 26 and later, private buffer reads begin sooner.
subtitle.zh: 改进 Metal 缓冲区的读回速度，减少临时内存占用。iOS 26 及以上版本可更快开始私有缓冲区读回。

subtitle.en: Improved Core ML MultiArray uploads and readback for contiguous arrays.
subtitle.zh: 改进 Core ML 连续 MultiArray 的上传和读回速度。

title.zh: iOS 17 上的 RealityKit 音频

subtitle.en: Fixed an iOS 17 launch crash related to RealityKit audio.
subtitle.zh: 修复 iOS 17 上与 RealityKit 音频有关的启动闪退。

subtitle.en: Improved Core ML prediction speed for UIImage inputs.
subtitle.zh: 改进 Core ML 使用 UIImage 输入时的预测速度。

title.zh: RealityKit 自定义 Metal 材质

subtitle.en: Added RealityKit custom Metal materials with surface shaders, geometry modifiers, and material-slot editing. iOS 18 or later supports reusable shader programs.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 自定义 Metal 材质，支持表面着色器、几何修改器和材质槽编辑。iOS 18 或更高版本可复用着色器程序。

title.zh: RealityKit 网格 GPU 写入

subtitle.en: Added Metal compute for RealityKit dynamic meshes on iOS 18 or later. Update vertices, indices, and mesh parts while the scene is running.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 动态网格的 Metal 计算支持（iOS 18 或更高版本），可在场景运行时更新顶点、索引和网格部件。

subtitle.en: Added RealityKit external textures on iOS 27 or later. Display BGRA camera frames and Core ML pixel buffers on scene materials.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 外部纹理（iOS 27 或更高版本），可在场景材质上显示 BGRA 相机帧和 Core ML 像素缓冲区。

subtitle.en: Added RealityKit low-level textures for regional updates and pixel readback on iOS 18 or later.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 低层纹理，支持更新局部区域和读回像素（iOS 18 或更高版本）。

subtitle.en: Added scene depth for Metal effects in mounted RealityKit views on compatible devices.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 视图的场景深度，可在兼容设备的 Metal 后处理效果中使用。

subtitle.en: Added Metal post-processing for live RealityKit views, with camera projection and scene time for effects that appear in snapshots.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 实时视图的 Metal 后处理，可用相机投影和场景时间控制效果，并在截图中呈现。

subtitle.en: Added Metal post-processing for RealityKit offscreen rendering on iOS 18 or later.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 离屏渲染的 Metal 后处理，支持 iOS 18 及以上。

subtitle.en: Added offscreen RealityKit rendering from BGRA camera frames and pixel buffers on iOS 27 or later.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 离屏外部纹理。iOS 27 或更高版本可直接渲染 BGRA 相机帧和像素缓冲区。

subtitle.en: Added RealityKit offscreen rendering on iOS 18 or later. Render images and advance animations by a chosen time step.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 离屏渲染。iOS 18 或更高版本可渲染图像，并按指定时间步长推进动画。

subtitle.en: Added GPU updates for RealityKit low-level textures. Run Metal kernels and display their results in an existing material on iOS 18 or later.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 低层纹理的 GPU 更新。iOS 18 或更高版本可运行 Metal 内核，并在现有材质中显示计算结果。

subtitle.en: Added RealityKit mesh instancing on iOS 26 or later, with shared transforms and per-part control.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 网格实例化，支持共享变换及按部件设置实例（iOS 26 或更高版本）。

title.zh: RealityKit 实例缓冲 GPU 写入

subtitle.en: Added Metal compute for RealityKit instance transforms on iOS 26 or later. Update selected transforms and the number of visible instances.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 实例变换的 Metal 计算支持（iOS 26 或更高版本），可更新选定实例的变换和可见实例数量。

subtitle.en: Added per-instance mesh attributes on iOS 27 or later. Give copies of the same mesh different colors or texture coordinates.
subtitle.zh: 新增逐实例网格属性（iOS 27 或更高版本），可为同一网格的不同实例设置各自的颜色或纹理坐标。

subtitle.en: Added RealityKit video materials for playing video on meshes. iOS 18 or later also supports automatic screen sizing and sample-buffer sources.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 视频表面，可在网格上播放视频。iOS 18 或更高版本支持自动设置屏幕尺寸和样本缓冲来源。

subtitle.en: Added RealityKit spatial audio. Play sounds from 3D entities and choose a listening position, with sound libraries and mix groups on iOS 18 or later.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 空间音频。可从三维实体播放声音并选择监听位置，iOS 18 或更新版本支持音频资源库和混音组。

subtitle.en: Added RealityKit animation graphs on iOS 27 or later. Import graphs from Reality Composer Pro or compile them from JSON, control graph parameters, and blend animations with joint masks.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 动画图，适用于 iOS 27 或更新版本。可从 Reality Composer Pro 导入或从 JSON 编译动画图、控制图参数，并使用关节遮罩混合动画。

title.zh: RealityKit 骨架资源和重定向

subtitle.en: Added reusable RealityKit skeletons, joint mask definitions, and animation retargeting for bipeds and quadrupeds on iOS 27 or later.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 可复用骨架、关节遮罩定义，以及双足和四足角色的动画重定向，适用于 iOS 27 或更新版本。

subtitle.en: Added RealityKit animation playback and programmatic clips, plus skeletal poses, blend shapes, and inverse kinematics on iOS 18 or later.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 动画播放和程序动画，并在 iOS 18 或更新版本上支持骨骼姿势、混合形状和逆向运动学。

subtitle.en: Added RealityKit scenes, 3D model loading, materials and RealityView, with dynamic meshes on iOS 18 or later.
subtitle.zh: 新增 RealityKit 场景、三维模型加载、材质和 RealityView，并在 iOS 18 或更新版本上支持动态网格。

subtitle.en: Added Accelerate Fourier transforms for Float32 and Float64 real and complex signals, with inverse transforms and normalization options.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Accelerate 傅里叶变换，支持 Float32 与 Float64 实数和复数信号的正反变换及归一化。

subtitle.en: Added Accelerate for Float32 and Float64 vector and matrix operations, linear systems and least-squares fitting, with reusable buffers.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Accelerate，支持 Float32 和 Float64 向量与矩阵运算、线性方程求解和最小二乘拟合，并可复用数值缓冲。

subtitle.en: Overview and supported numerical capabilities.
subtitle.zh: 概览与支持的数值能力。

subtitle.en: Create, upload, read and reuse numerical buffers.
subtitle.zh: 创建、上传、读取与复用数值缓冲。

subtitle.en: Vector and matrix operations in Float32 and Float64.
subtitle.zh: Float32 与 Float64 向量和矩阵运算。

subtitle.en: Elementwise arithmetic, math functions and reductions.
subtitle.zh: 逐元素运算、数学函数与归约。

subtitle.en: Solve linear systems and fit least-squares solutions.
subtitle.zh: 线性方程求解与最小二乘拟合。

subtitle.en: Layouts, cancellation, ownership and errors.
subtitle.zh: 布局、取消、资源所有权与错误。

subtitle.en: Added UIImage.fromPixels, UIImage.fromRGBA and UIImage.toPixels for creating and reading raw image pixels.
subtitle.zh: 新增 UIImage.fromPixels、UIImage.fromRGBA 和 UIImage.toPixels，可直接创建与读取图像像素。

subtitle.en: Added Vision still-image face detection, facial landmarks, 2D body and hand poses, with request batches and coordinate conversion.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Vision 静态图像人脸检测、面部关键点、二维人体与手部姿态，支持请求批处理和坐标转换。

subtitle.en: Added built-in NumPy for offline array operations, linear algebra, random sampling, and FFT in Python.
subtitle.zh: 新增内置 NumPy，可在 Python 中离线进行数组运算、线性代数、随机采样和 FFT。

subtitle.en: Added synchronized camera video and depth with native timestamps, drop reasons, depth maps, and camera calibration on supported devices.
subtitle.zh: 新增同步相机视频与深度，可在支持的设备上读取原生时间戳、丢帧原因、深度图与相机校准数据。

subtitle.en: Added live camera frames from AVCaptureSession with timestamps, color information, and BGRA or NV12 pixel data.
subtitle.zh: 新增 AVCaptureSession 实时相机帧，支持读取时间戳、色彩信息及 BGRA 或 NV12 像素数据。

subtitle.en: Added ARKit full-body tracking on supported devices, with live 3D joint transforms, 2D landmarks, and camera tracking data.
subtitle.zh: 新增 ARKit 全身跟踪，支持在兼容设备上实时读取三维关节变换、二维关键点和相机跟踪数据。

subtitle.en: Added ARKit face tracking on supported devices, with a live 3D face mesh, expression weights, and eye movements.
subtitle.zh: 新增 ARKit 人脸跟踪，可在兼容设备上实时读取三维人脸网格、表情权重和眼部运动。

subtitle.en: Added ARKit world tracking on supported devices, with plane detection, raycasts, and spatial anchors.
subtitle.zh: 新增 ARKit 世界跟踪，可在兼容设备上检测平面、执行射线查询及放置空间锚点。

subtitle.en: Added ARKit world maps to save a scanned space and restore its anchors in another session.
subtitle.zh: 新增 ARKit 世界地图，可保存扫描的空间，并在另一个会话恢复其中的锚点。

subtitle.en: Added raw and smoothed ARKit scene depth, with confidence maps on supported LiDAR devices.
subtitle.zh: 新增 ARKit 原始和平滑场景深度，可在兼容 LiDAR 设备上读取置信图。

subtitle.en: Added ARKit scene mesh reconstruction, with triangle geometry and optional surface classifications on supported LiDAR devices.
subtitle.zh: 新增 ARKit 场景网格，可在兼容 LiDAR 设备上读取三角网格及可选的表面分类。

subtitle.en: Added Vision tracking of object boxes and rectangle corners across image sequences and live camera frames.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Vision 连续跟踪，可在图像序列和实时相机帧中跟踪物体边界框及矩形角点。

subtitle.en: Added Vision translation and perspective alignment for image sequences and live camera frames.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Vision 平移和透视配准，可对齐图像序列与实时相机帧。

subtitle.en: Added Vision trajectory detection for moving objects in image sequences and live camera frames.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Vision 轨迹检测，可在图像序列和实时相机帧中识别运动物体的抛物线轨迹。

subtitle.en: Added Vision optical flow with Float32, Float16, and raw network output for consecutive frames.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Vision 光流分析，支持连续帧的 Float32、Float16 和原始网络输出。

subtitle.en: Added LiveText.analyze to read text from still images and LiveTextView to select and copy text directly in script views. Available on supported iPhone and iPad models with iOS or iPadOS 17 or later.
subtitle.zh: 新增 LiveText.analyze，可读取静态图片中的文字。新增 LiveTextView，可直接在脚本界面的图片中选取和复制文字。适用于运行 iOS 或 iPadOS 17 及更新版本的受支持 iPhone 和 iPad。

subtitle.en: Added Vision requests for Core ML image models, with classification, object detection, image and feature results.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Vision 的 Core ML 图像模型请求，可返回分类、目标检测、图像和模型特征。

subtitle.en: Added Vision analysis of live camera frames for faces, facial landmarks, body poses, and hands.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Vision 实时相机帧分析，支持人脸、面部关键点、人体姿态和手部检测。

subtitle.en: Added Vision 3D body pose on iOS 17 or later. Estimate 17 joints from a full-body photo and project them onto the image.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Vision 三维人体姿态，支持 iOS 17 或更新版本。可从全身照片估计 17 个关节，并将关节投影到图像上。

subtitle.en: Added CoreML for local model inference, batch prediction and supported model updates with saving. Model functions and stateful prediction require iOS 18 or later.
subtitle.zh: 新增 CoreML，可执行本地模型推理、批量预测，并更新与保存支持的模型。模型函数和有状态预测需要 iOS 18 或更新系统。

subtitle.en: Start here for global APIs, supported systems and the documentation map.
subtitle.zh: 从全局 API、系统要求与文档导航开始。

subtitle.en: Load models, validate features, predict and save supported models.
subtitle.zh: 加载模型、校验特征、执行推理及保存支持的模型。

subtitle.en: Compile assets, provide weights, select functions and configure execution.
subtitle.zh: 编译模型资产、提供权重、选择函数并配置执行方式。

subtitle.en: Manage model state, ordered batches and reusable output buffers.
subtitle.zh: 管理模型状态、有序批量推理与输出缓冲复用。

subtitle.en: Update supported models, observe progress, cancel and save results.
subtitle.zh: 更新支持的模型、观察进度、取消任务并保存结果。

subtitle.en: Check capabilities and manage cancellation, disposal, limits and errors.
subtitle.zh: 查询能力并管理取消、释放、资源上限及错误。

title.en: CoreML Arrays, Tensors and Model Inspection
title.zh: CoreML 数组、张量与模型检查

subtitle.en: Added CoreML.MultiArray and CoreML.Tensor for numerical data and calculations, plus model structure and compute-plan inspection. Tensor requires iOS 18 or later.
subtitle.zh: 新增 CoreML.MultiArray 和 CoreML.Tensor，用于数值数据与计算，并支持查看模型结构和计算计划。Tensor 需要 iOS 18 或更新系统。

subtitle.en: Work with typed values, shapes, strides, slices and pixel-buffer storage.
subtitle.zh: 使用带类型的数据、形状、步长、切片及像素缓冲存储。

subtitle.en: Create tensors, calculate, transform, index and copy results.
subtitle.zh: 创建张量、计算、变换、索引并拷出结果。

subtitle.en: Inspect model structure, expected compute devices and estimated costs.
subtitle.zh: 查看模型结构、预期计算设备与估算成本。

subtitle.en: Added PixelBuffer camera frame copying with resizing, orientation and model image formats.
subtitle.zh: 新增 PixelBuffer 相机帧复制，支持调整尺寸、方向和转换为模型所需的图像格式。

subtitle.en: Added PixelBuffer region updates, NV12 planes, and timed display of raw pixel buffers.
subtitle.zh: 新增 PixelBuffer 区域更新、NV12 像素平面和原始像素的定时显示。

subtitle.en: Added PixelBuffer for model image inputs and outputs, with pixel copying and UIImage conversion.
subtitle.zh: 新增 PixelBuffer，可用于模型图像输入与输出，支持拷出像素并与 UIImage 转换。

subtitle.en: Added a script run log when the app process ends during a Python project.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Python 项目中断记录，App 进程在执行期间结束时，下次打开可在脚本运行日志中查看。

subtitle.en: Fixed Python scripts to reload edited local modules on each run.
subtitle.zh: 修复 Python 脚本再次运行时仍读取旧版模块的问题，重新运行即可载入修改后的本地模块。

subtitle.en: Improved script screenshots with delayed preview capture and a final screenshot at script exit.
subtitle.zh: 改进脚本截图，支持延迟截取预览以及在脚本退出时保存最终画面。

subtitle.en: Improved Section diagnostics for inline JSX whitespace and added an editor quick fix.
subtitle.zh: 改进 Section 的 JSX 同行空白诊断，并在编辑器中加入快速修复。

subtitle.en: Fixed FileManager.readAsBytesSync to return Uint8Array. For numeric views, use bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset and bytes.byteLength divided by the element size. See the latest FileManager documentation.
subtitle.zh: 修复 FileManager.readAsBytesSync，统一返回 Uint8Array。创建数值视图时，请改用 bytes.buffer、bytes.byteOffset，以及 bytes.byteLength 除以元素字节数；详见最新 FileManager 文档。

title.zh: API 查询与视图修饰符

subtitle.en: Improved API search and documentation to show existing shared view modifiers alongside component props, including buttonStyle, background and clipShape.
subtitle.zh: 改进 API 查询与文档，将 buttonStyle、background、clipShape 等已有通用视图修饰符与组件属性一起展示。

subtitle.en: Added Device APIs to read the hardware model, check Dynamic Island support, and inspect screen and window geometry. On iOS 27.1 and later, Device.occlusionRegions reports areas covered by system elements.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Device API，可读取硬件型号、查询灵动岛支持情况，并获取屏幕和窗口几何。iOS 27.1 及以上可通过 Device.occlusionRegions 读取系统遮挡区域。

subtitle.en: Added Device screen capture status and change notifications for screen recording and mirroring.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Device 屏幕捕获状态与变化通知，脚本可感知录屏和镜像的启停。

subtitle.en: Added Device APIs to read, adjust, and monitor the main screen brightness.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Device API，可读取、调节并监听主屏幕亮度。

subtitle.en: Added the display's maximum refresh rate, Low Power Mode status, and thermal state to Device.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Device 设备状态，可读取显示器最高刷新率、低电量模式及系统热状态。

subtitle.en: Added HDR highlights for text, SF Symbols, shapes, and backgrounds on iOS and iPadOS 26 and later.
subtitle.zh: 新增 HDR 高光样式，可在 iOS 和 iPadOS 26 及以上用于文字、SF Symbols、形状和背景。

subtitle.en: Connect to your computer or NAS without enabling VPN.
subtitle.zh: 不开启 VPN，连接自己的电脑或 NAS。

subtitle.en: Run commands on your Tailnet devices through SSH.
subtitle.zh: 通过 SSH 在自己的 Tailnet 设备上执行命令。

subtitle.en: List directories and use the existing SFTP file APIs.
subtitle.zh: 查看目录，并使用现有 SFTP 文件 API。

subtitle.en: Local/network playback, composable controls, tracks, subtitles, danmaku and frames.
subtitle.zh: 本地与网络播放、可组合控件、轨道、字幕、弹幕及视频帧。

subtitle.en: Added native audio/video sample playback, a synchronized timeline and a runnable example.
subtitle.zh: 新增原生音视频样本播放、同步时间线及可运行示例。

subtitle.en: Choose system or software decoding and inspect the selected backend.
subtitle.zh: 选择系统或软件解码，并查看实际使用的后端。

subtitle.en: Added browser settings, request loading, navigation events and policies, user scripts, asynchronous messages and content rules.
subtitle.zh: 新增浏览器设置、请求加载、导航事件与策略、用户脚本、异步消息及内容规则。

subtitle.en: Added adaptive primary/secondary layouts with split and overlay sizing and placement preferences (iOS 27.1+).
subtitle.zh: 新增主次内容自适应布局，以及分割、叠放布局的尺寸和位置偏好（iOS 27.1+）。

subtitle.en: Added toolbarVerticalBehavior, toolbarVerticalCompressionBehavior and toolbar item axisBehavior (iOS 27.1+).
subtitle.zh: 新增 toolbarVerticalBehavior、toolbarVerticalCompressionBehavior 与工具栏项 axisBehavior（iOS 27.1+）。

subtitle.en: Added onHingeChange with old/new context, hinge status and angle (iOS 27.1+).
subtitle.zh: 新增 onHingeChange，提供变化前后的铰链状态与角度（iOS 27.1+）。

subtitle.en: Added GeometryProxy.reservedRegions snapshots for occlusions and divisions (iOS 27.1+).
subtitle.zh: 新增 GeometryProxy.reservedRegions，可读取遮挡与分割区域快照（iOS 27.1+）。

subtitle.en: Added contentMargins with the container guide (iOS 27.1+).
subtitle.zh: 新增 contentMargins 的 container guide 形式（iOS 27.1+）。

subtitle.en: Added toolbarVerticalEdge and overlayArrangementZIndex environment values (iOS 27.1+).
subtitle.zh: 新增 toolbarVerticalEdge、overlayArrangementZIndex 环境值（iOS 27.1+）。

title.zh: 菜单操作后的关闭行为

subtitle.en: Added menuActionDismissBehavior to keep a menu open after selected actions or dismiss it (iOS 16.4+).
subtitle.zh: 新增 menuActionDismissBehavior，可在执行指定操作后保持菜单打开或关闭菜单（iOS 16.4+）。

subtitle.en: Added a native AirPlay output-selection button for script pages.
subtitle.zh: 新增可在脚本页面直接选择 AirPlay 输出的原生按钮。

subtitle.en: Added JSX external content with shared script state and controls kept on the device.
subtitle.zh: 新增共享脚本状态的 JSX 外屏内容，控制保留在本机。

title.en: Remote Widget and Live Activity Updates
title.zh: 小组件与 Live Activity 远程更新

subtitle.en: Added remote widget updates and remote Live Activity starts, updates, and endings from scripts or external servers.
subtitle.zh: 新增通过脚本或外部服务器远程更新小组件，以及启动、更新和结束 Live Activity。

subtitle.en: Added AirPlay output selection through a panel or AirPlayRoutePicker, playback-route detection, and audio-session routing and external-video playback controls.
subtitle.zh: 新增 AirPlay 输出选择面板与 AirPlayRoutePicker 控件、播放路由检测，以及音频会话路由和视频外部播放控制。

subtitle.en: Added independent image display on connected screens.
subtitle.zh: 新增在连接的外屏上独立展示图片。

title.zh: 键盘加载与触摸稳定性

subtitle.en: Fixed crashes when using custom keyboard touch controls. Improved keyboard loading with timeout recovery and retry controls.
subtitle.zh: 修复使用自定义键盘触摸控件时的崩溃。改进键盘加载，提供超时恢复和重试操作。

subtitle.en: Added native device-service connections, lossless 64-bit plist integers, native RSD service-name discovery, AFC file transfers and independent service sessions. Matching RSD tunnels can be shared across scripts; close now releases only the calling handle. See the updated LocalDevVPN documentation.
subtitle.zh: 新增原生设备服务连接、64 位 plist 整数无损读写、原生 RSD 服务名称发现、AFC 文件传输及独立服务会话。匹配的 RSD 隧道可跨脚本共享；close 现在仅释放调用句柄，请参照最新 LocalDevVPN 文档调整。

subtitle.en: Added BluetoothBackground and bluetooth.tsx to register background Bluetooth tasks, handle device events, and save state between events.
subtitle.zh: 新增 BluetoothBackground 和 bluetooth.tsx，可注册后台蓝牙任务、处理设备事件，并在事件之间保存状态。

subtitle.en: Added native Data input and stream methods, configurable opening deadlines and cancellation with cleanup before retrying.
subtitle.zh: 新增原生 Data 输入与流读写方法、可配置的打开期限与显式取消，完成清理后可重试。

subtitle.en: Added priority to expanded regions for ordinary and Alarm Live Activities.
subtitle.zh: 普通与闹钟实时活动展开区域新增 priority。

subtitle.en: Added public script services with reusable instances and independent replies; same-script extension requests remain supported.
subtitle.zh: 新增可复用实例、独立返回结果的公开脚本服务，保留同脚本扩展请求通信。

subtitle.en: Added asynchronous system network-path snapshots and change listeners with complete import examples.
subtitle.zh: 新增异步系统网络路径查询与变化监听，提供完整导入示例。

subtitle.en: Improved access error reporting and cleanup for Bonjour, TCP/TLS, VPN and extended cryptography.
subtitle.zh: 改进 Bonjour、TCP/TLS、VPN 和扩展加密的访问错误处理及资源清理。

subtitle.en: Added Device.appVersion and Device.appBuildNumber for Scripting version information.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Device.appVersion 和 Device.appBuildNumber，读取 Scripting 的版本号与构建号。

subtitle.en: Added native point and coordinate conversion for rotated and pitched maps, with complete import and gesture examples.
subtitle.zh: 新增旋转、倾斜地图的原生点与经纬度转换，提供完整导入与手势示例。

subtitle.en: Improved repeated switching and reopening, and fixed Rime sessions retaining database resources after script exit. Keyboard scripts restart when reopened; persist state you need to retain and see the updated documentation.
subtitle.zh: 改进反复切换与重新打开键盘的稳定性，修复脚本退出后 Rime 会话仍持有数据库资源的问题。重新打开键盘会重启脚本，需要保留的状态请持久化，详见更新后的文档。

subtitle.en: Added module support tables, explicit imports and complete network, crypto and timer examples.
subtitle.zh: 新增模块支持范围、明确导入方式，以及完整的网络、加密和定时器示例。

subtitle.en: Added global intervals and improved cancellation and Node timer promises. Updated the default minimum to 1 ms and Immediate handles; see the migration notes.
subtitle.zh: 新增全局 interval，改进取消和 Node 定时器 Promise；兜底延迟改为1毫秒，Immediate 返回 handle，迁移方式见文档。

subtitle.en: Added system service publication, browsing and resolution with binary TXT records.
subtitle.zh: 新增系统服务发布、浏览与解析，支持二进制 TXT 记录。

subtitle.en: Added HKDF key derivation and authenticated ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption for ordinary scripts.
subtitle.zh: 新增适用于普通脚本的 HKDF 密钥派生和 ChaCha20-Poly1305 认证加密。

subtitle.en: Added verified TLS 1.2/1.3 streams with custom certificate authorities, SNI and ALPN. Fixed writes started in secureConnect callbacks.
subtitle.zh: 新增经过证书验证的 TLS 1.2/1.3 字节流，支持自定义 CA、SNI 和 ALPN；修复在 secureConnect 回调中开始写入的问题。

subtitle.en: Added X25519 key agreement and Ed25519 signatures to crypto.subtle and node:crypto.webcrypto, with native opaque keys and standard key formats.
subtitle.zh: 为 crypto.subtle 与 node:crypto.webcrypto 新增 X25519 密钥派生与 Ed25519 签名，支持原生不透明密钥及标准密钥格式。

title.zh: Node TCP 客户端与服务端

subtitle.en: Added native TCP servers and clients with binary streams, backpressure, half-close, cancellation and script-exit cleanup. Fixed writes started in connection callbacks.
subtitle.zh: 新增原生 TCP 服务端与客户端，支持二进制流、背压、半关闭、取消和退出清理；修复在建连回调中开始写入的问题。

title.zh: VPN 与 LocalDevVPN 脚本 API

subtitle.en: Global VPN control, reflection state and RSD sessions through Scripting or an external VPN, with lifecycle and transport diagnostics. Migrate LocalDevVPN calls to VPN.localDevVPN.
subtitle.zh: 全局 VPN 启停、反射状态及支持外部 VPN 的 RSD 会话，提供生命周期与传输诊断；旧 LocalDevVPN 调用迁移至 VPN.localDevVPN。

subtitle.en: Configure HTTP access with one API key and optional HTTPS, and use VPN routing, policy groups, feature switches and traffic endpoints.
subtitle.zh: 在配置中设置单一 API 密钥与可选 HTTPS，调用 VPN 路由、策略组、功能开关及流量端点。

subtitle.en: Inspect actual audio activity, interruptions and your script's keep-alive request with BackgroundKeeper.getState().
subtitle.zh: 通过 BackgroundKeeper.getState() 检查实际音频活动、中断和当前脚本的保活申请。

subtitle.en: Fixed userscript loading through directory and file aliases, preserving valid linked scripts and rejecting unsafe file replacements.
subtitle.zh: 修复目录及文件别名下的用户脚本加载，保留合法文件链接兼容性，并拒绝不安全的文件替换。

subtitle.en: Fixed GM.cookie reads, writes and deletion to use the script tab's Safari cookie store, including profiles and private browsing.
subtitle.zh: 修复 GM.cookie 读取、写入和删除未使用脚本标签页对应 Safari Cookie store 的问题，支持个人资料及无痕会话隔离。

subtitle.en: Translation.translateInstalled and translateInstalledBatch use already-installed languages without a translation host or download prompts. Requires explicit source. Safari exposes only these new methods through Scripting.Translation with its grant.
subtitle.zh: Translation.translateInstalled 和 translateInstalledBatch 无需翻译宿主或下载提示，使用已安装语言；源语言必填。Safari 仅通过带授权的 Scripting.Translation 提供这两个新方法。

title.en: Native Touch Events for Custom Keyboards
title.zh: 自定义键盘原生触摸事件

subtitle.en: iOS 18+: onTouchGesture receives per-finger UIKit began, moved, ended and cancelled events with local positions, translation, measured velocity and native timing. Supports JSX and chained modifiers; existing DragGesture behavior is unchanged.
subtitle.zh: iOS 18+：onTouchGesture 接收 UIKit 的逐指开始、移动、结束和取消事件，提供 local 位置、位移、实测速度与原生时间。支持 JSX 和链式修饰符；已有 DragGesture 行为不变。

title.en: Dynamic Island Keyline and Content Margins
title.zh: 灵动岛系统轮廓与内容边距

subtitle.en: LiveActivityUI.keylineTint and per-mode dynamicIslandContentMargins configure WidgetKit's native Dynamic Island appearance. Custom Alarm Live Activity UI shares this support.
subtitle.zh: LiveActivityUI.keylineTint 与分模式 dynamicIslandContentMargins 配置 WidgetKit 原生灵动岛外观，Alarm 自定义实时活动 UI 同样支持。

subtitle.en: iOS 17+: GeometryProxy.frame(space) reads layout snapshots in local, global, named and scroll-view spaces. Declare additional spaces with coordinateSpaces. Includes a position-change example.
subtitle.zh: iOS 17+：GeometryProxy.frame(space) 读取 local、global、命名及滚动坐标空间的布局快照，使用 coordinateSpaces 声明额外空间。包含位置变化示例。

title.en: Scroll Geometry, Phases and Element Visibility
title.zh: 滚动几何、阶段与单元素可见性

subtitle.en: iOS 18+: onScrollGeometryChange selects native fields and reports old/new values; onScrollPhaseChange provides geometry and optional velocity context; onScrollVisibilityChange observes individual elements. Includes JSX and chained examples and iOS 17 behavior.
subtitle.zh: iOS 18+：onScrollGeometryChange 选择原生字段并回调旧值/新值；onScrollPhaseChange 提供几何与可空速度上下文；onScrollVisibilityChange 观察单元素可见性。包含 JSX、链式示例及 iOS 17 行为。

title.zh: Breaking Change：小组件快捷指令列表

subtitle.en: Replaces four shortcut slots and Button.shortcut with an editable Shortcuts list and zero-based Button.shortcutIndex. Adds Widget.shortcutCount. Reconfigure actions in existing test widgets; deleting or reordering items changes their indices.
subtitle.zh: 以可添加、删除和排序的 Shortcuts 列表及从 0 开始的 Button.shortcutIndex 替换四槽位和 Button.shortcut，新增 Widget.shortcutCount。旧测试小组件需要重新配置动作；删除或排序会改变索引。

subtitle.en: Adds showsPlaybackControls and renderingMode; custom context-menu previews default to layer while pages retain native controls.
subtitle.zh: 新增 showsPlaybackControls 与 renderingMode；自定义长按菜单预览默认采用 Layer，普通页面保留原生控件。

subtitle.en: Request video PiP from JavaScript with explicit layer binding, readiness and lifecycle callbacks, audio setup and cleanup.
subtitle.zh: 通过显式 Layer 绑定由 JS 主动请求视频 PiP，说明就绪状态、生命周期回调、音频配置及资源清理。

title.en: Presentation Appearance and Local Color Scheme
title.zh: 弹窗外观与局部配色模式

subtitle.en: Fixes preferredColorScheme in Navigation.present and documents presentation scope, dynamic updates and inheritance when cleared. Adds environments.colorScheme for local overrides and explains EnvironmentValuesReader versus useColorScheme.
subtitle.zh: 修复 Navigation.present 中的 preferredColorScheme，并说明呈递作用范围、动态切换和清除后的外观继承。新增 environments.colorScheme 局部覆盖，说明 EnvironmentValuesReader 与 useColorScheme 的区别。

subtitle.en: Documents CustomShape with an animatable numeric value and a synchronous path(value, rect) builder returning Path2D, including animation usage, fill/stroke/trim support and a morphing example.
subtitle.zh: 补充 CustomShape 文档：通过可动画数值 value 和同步返回 Path2D 的 path(value, rect) 回调驱动轮廓变形，包含动画用法、fill/stroke/trim 支持与变形示例。

subtitle.en: New scripting APIs for tabs, toolbars, controls, presentation, gestures, drag and drop, reordering, clipboard and geometry. Each topic documents availability, fallbacks and examples.
subtitle.zh: 补充标签、工具栏、控件、呈现、手势、拖放、重排、剪贴板与几何信息 API，各主题包含系统版本要求、降级行为和示例。

subtitle.en: Tab.role adds prominent; defaultTabBarPlacement requests a static tab bar or sidebar layout. Includes availability and fallback behavior.
subtitle.zh: Tab.role 新增 prominent，defaultTabBarPlacement 可请求静态标签栏或侧边栏布局，并说明系统版本与降级行为。

title.en: Toolbar Overflow, Minimization and Item Options
title.zh: 工具栏溢出、最小化与项目选项

subtitle.en: Adds toolbarOverflowMenu, toolbarVisibility, three minimization modifiers, visibilityPriority, contentMarginsRemoved, topBarPinnedTrailing and statusBar placement. toolbarVisibility supports iOS 18+; the other additions require iOS 27+.
subtitle.zh: 新增 toolbarOverflowMenu、toolbarVisibility、三个最小化修饰符、visibilityPriority、contentMarginsRemoved、topBarPinnedTrailing 及 statusBar 位置。toolbarVisibility 支持 iOS 18+，其他新增选项要求 iOS 27+。

subtitle.en: textFieldStyle adds bordered; textInputBorderShape supports automatic, capsule and roundedRectangle, with earlier-system fallbacks.
subtitle.zh: textFieldStyle 新增 bordered，textInputBorderShape 支持 automatic、capsule 和 roundedRectangle，并说明旧系统降级行为。

subtitle.en: pickerStyle adds tabs on iOS 27+, falling back to segmented on earlier systems.
subtitle.zh: pickerStyle 新增 tabs 样式（iOS 27+），旧系统降级为 segmented。

subtitle.en: navigationTransition adds crossFade on iOS 27+, falling back to automatic on earlier systems.
subtitle.zh: navigationTransition 新增 crossFade（iOS 27+），旧系统回退为 automatic。

subtitle.en: presentationPlacement supports automatic, leading, center and trailing on iOS 27+.
subtitle.zh: presentationPlacement 新增 automatic、leading、center、trailing 位置选项（iOS 27+）。

subtitle.en: dismissalConfirmationDialog confirms user-initiated dismissal on iOS 27+, with shouldPresent, actions and an optional message.
subtitle.zh: dismissalConfirmationDialog 支持 iOS 27+ 的用户关闭确认，提供 shouldPresent、actions 和可选 message。

title.en: Swipe Actions Containers and Presentation Events
title.zh: 侧滑操作容器与展开事件

subtitle.en: Adds swipeActionsContainer and onPresentationChanged for leadingSwipeActions and trailingSwipeActions on iOS 27+.
subtitle.zh: 新增 swipeActionsContainer，以及 leadingSwipeActions / trailingSwipeActions 的 onPresentationChanged 回调（iOS 27+）。

subtitle.en: GestureInputKinds filters directTouch, indirectTouch, pencil and pointer for tap, long press, drag, rotate and magnify gestures on iOS 27+.
subtitle.zh: GestureInputKinds 可为点击、长按、拖动、旋转和缩放手势过滤 directTouch、indirectTouch、pencil、pointer 输入来源（iOS 27+）。

title.en: Drag Sessions, Containers and Text Clipboard
title.zh: 拖放会话、容器与文本剪贴板

subtitle.en: Adds drag/drop configuration, session snapshots, string drag containers and selection, plus copyable, cuttable and pasteDestination on iOS 27+.
subtitle.zh: 新增拖放配置、会话快照、字符串拖拽容器与选择，以及 copyable、cuttable、pasteDestination 文本剪贴板接口（iOS 27+）。

subtitle.en: ForEach.reorderable and reorderContainer support single or multiple collections on iOS 27+. move returns source IDs and a destination; update Observable data in the callback.
subtitle.zh: ForEach.reorderable 与 reorderContainer 支持单集合和多集合原生重排（iOS 27+）。move 返回来源 ID 和目标位置，需在回调中更新 Observable 数据。

subtitle.en: GeometryProxy.concentricCornerRadii exposes a layout snapshot on iOS 27+, returning null when unavailable.
subtitle.zh: GeometryProxy.concentricCornerRadii 提供 iOS 27+ 的布局圆角快照，不可用时返回 null。

title.en: Screen Capture: Video, Audio and Timing
title.zh: 屏幕采集：视频、音频与时钟

subtitle.en: Added script cameras, Lock Screen photo/video handoff, physical capture events and default script selection.
subtitle.zh: 新增脚本相机、锁屏照片与视频交接、实体拍摄事件和默认脚本选择。

subtitle.en: System capture entry requirements, script lifecycle, setup and a complete example.
subtitle.zh: 系统拍摄入口要求、脚本生命周期、设置与完整示例。

subtitle.en: Fixed camera script restoration, startup failure reporting and cleanup after errors, cancellation or script exit. Improved Lock Screen camera startup, capture handoff recovery, capture controls and viewfinder layout, and clarified system capture requirements for custom scripts.
subtitle.zh: 修复相机脚本恢复、启动失败提示，以及错误、取消或退出后的资源清理；改进锁屏相机启动、拍摄文件交接恢复、拍摄控件与取景布局，并说明自定义脚本的系统拍摄入口要求。

subtitle.en: Fixed a crash when requesting access to medication dose events. Medication and dose queries now share the same medication selection permissions.
subtitle.zh: 修复请求服药记录访问权限时的崩溃。用药与服药记录查询现共用同一套用药选择权限。

subtitle.en: Record, process, mix and export audio; host MIDI instruments and Audio Unit plugins.
subtitle.zh: 录制、处理、混合与导出音频，托管 MIDI 乐器与 Audio Unit 插件。

title.en: Audio Unit Plugins and Native Editors
title.zh: Audio Unit 插件与原生编辑器
小组件系统快捷指令按钮（iOS 27+）

subtitle.en: Existing widgets now offer four optional shortcut slots. Use Button.shortcut to run user-configured shortcuts, App Shortcuts, system actions, or apps. Also adds the systemExtraLargePortrait family and in-app layout preview.
subtitle.zh: 现有小组件新增四个可选快捷指令槽位，通过 Button.shortcut 执行用户配置的快捷指令、App Shortcut、系统动作或打开 App。同时支持 systemExtraLargePortrait 类型及应用内布局预览。

subtitle.en: A script that provides a `home_screen_default_ui.tsx` file can now be rendered as a tab on the app's home screen. Turn on Show Home Tab in Settings.
subtitle.zh: 提供 `home_screen_default_ui.tsx` 的脚本现在可以作为 App 首页的一个 Tab 渲染。在「设置」中打开 Show Home Tab 开关。

subtitle.en: Notification.schedule adds a `sound` option to play a custom sound, and local notifications now play a sound by default. Import and manage custom sounds under Tools > Notifications > Notification Sounds.
subtitle.zh: Notification.schedule 新增 `sound` 选项可播放自定义铃声,本地通知现在默认有声。可在「工具 > 通知 > 通知铃声」中导入和管理自定义铃声。

subtitle.en: Archive adds create7z, list7z, and extract7z for creating, inspecting, and extracting AES-256 encrypted 7z archives with progress and cancellation.
subtitle.zh: Archive 新增 create7z、list7z 和 extract7z，可创建、查看和解压 AES-256 加密的 7z 归档，并支持进度和取消。

subtitle.en: Archive adds createZip and extractZip for creating and extracting regular or WinZip AES-256 encrypted ZIP archives without loading whole files into memory.
subtitle.zh: Archive 新增 createZip 和 extractZip，可创建和解压普通或使用 WinZip AES-256 加密的 ZIP 归档，并适合处理大文件。

subtitle.en: New view modifiers: alignmentGuide, color & filter effects, truncationMode, dynamicTypeSize, scrollBounceBehavior, scenePadding, and presentationBackground.
subtitle.zh: 新增视图修饰器:alignmentGuide、颜色与滤镜效果、truncationMode、dynamicTypeSize、scrollBounceBehavior、scenePadding、presentationBackground。

subtitle.en: Sets an explicit alignment guide for one of a view's alignments using a constant or a dimension keyword (leading/trailing/width/…), with an optional offset.
subtitle.zh: 用常量或维度关键字(leading/trailing/width 等)为视图的某个对齐设置显式对齐 guide,支持可选偏移。

subtitle.en: brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale, colorMultiply, luminanceToAlpha and blendMode adjust the rendered colors of a view.
subtitle.zh: brightness、contrast、saturation、grayscale、colorMultiply、luminanceToAlpha、blendMode,用于调整视图渲染的颜色。

subtitle.en: Sets how text that is too long to fit is truncated (head / middle / tail). Pair with lineLimit.
subtitle.zh: 设置放不下的文本如何截断(head / middle / tail),需配合 lineLimit。

subtitle.en: Overrides the Dynamic Type size for content in a view — fix a size, or clamp the user's size within a range.
subtitle.zh: 覆盖视图内容的动态字体大小——固定为某尺寸,或把用户尺寸限制在区间内。

subtitle.en: Configures the bounce behavior of scrollable views (automatic / always / basedOnSize) along an axis.
subtitle.zh: 配置可滚动视图在某方向上的回弹行为(automatic / always / basedOnSize)。

subtitle.en: Adds padding using the space the system considers appropriate for the current scene, on chosen edges.
subtitle.zh: 按系统认为当前场景合适的间距,为选定的边添加内边距。

subtitle.en: Sets the background of the enclosing sheet or popover to a color or material.
subtitle.zh: 把所在 sheet 或 popover 的背景设为颜色或材质。

subtitle.en: Accessibility labels, traits, default/named actions, and custom VoiceOver navigation rotors.
subtitle.zh: 无障碍标签、特征、默认/命名操作，以及自定义旁白导航转子。

subtitle.en: Rotates a view's rendered output in three dimensions around a given axis, with anchor and perspective.
subtitle.zh: 围绕指定轴在三维空间旋转视图渲染输出,支持锚点与透视。

subtitle.en: Applies a raw CGAffineTransform (a/b/c/d/tx/ty) to a view — useful for effects like shear.
subtitle.zh: 对视图应用裸 CGAffineTransform(a/b/c/d/tx/ty),可实现错切等效果。

subtitle.en: Names this view's coordinate space so gestures can report locations relative to it.
subtitle.zh: 为该视图的坐标空间命名,手势即可相对它上报位置。

subtitle.en: Requests a sizing behavior (automatic / fitted / page / form) for the enclosing sheet. iOS 18+.
subtitle.zh: 为所在 sheet 请求尺寸行为(automatic / fitted / page / form),iOS 18+。

subtitle.en: Applies a pointer hover effect (automatic / highlight / lift) on iPadOS.
subtitle.zh: 在 iPadOS 上应用指针悬停效果(automatic / highlight / lift)。

subtitle.en: Runs a callback when a pointer enters or exits the view (iPadOS).
subtitle.zh: 指针进入或离开视图时触发回调(iPadOS)。

subtitle.en: Sets help text — a tooltip with a pointer, an accessibility hint for VoiceOver.
subtitle.zh: 设置帮助文本——指针下为 tooltip,对 VoiceOver 为无障碍提示。

subtitle.en: Captures a rendered view as a UIImage on demand via a ScreenshotMaker ref.
subtitle.zh: 通过 ScreenshotMaker ref 按需把已渲染视图捕获为 UIImage。

subtitle.en: New UIImage methods: averageColor, dominantColors, pixelColor, getPixelData, croppedTo, rotated, blurred, grayscale.
subtitle.zh: UIImage 新增方法：averageColor、dominantColors、pixelColor、getPixelData、croppedTo、rotated、blurred、grayscale。

subtitle.en: MapSnapshotter.take now draws polyline/polygon/circle overlays and pin annotations onto the image, with automatic framing — turn a MapDirections route into a picture in one call.
subtitle.zh: MapSnapshotter.take 现在能把 polyline/polygon/circle 叠加层与标注 pin 画到图片上,并自动取景——一次调用即可把 MapDirections 路线转成图片。

subtitle.en: EnvironmentValuesReader can now read dynamicTypeSize — the user's preferred Dynamic Type size, including accessibility sizes.
subtitle.zh: EnvironmentValuesReader 现在可读取 dynamicTypeSize——用户偏好的动态字号档,含无障碍字号。

title.zh: 把普通视频变成实况照片

subtitle.en: LivePhoto.createFromVideo turns any local video into a still + movie pair that Photos.saveLivePhoto accepts, with stillTime for the cover frame and maxDuration for the length (10 seconds by default, up to the whole video).
subtitle.zh: LivePhoto.createFromVideo 把任意本地视频转成 Photos.saveLivePhoto 能接受的静态图 + 视频资源对,用 stillTime 指定封面帧、maxDuration 指定时长(默认 10 秒,最长可到整段视频)。

subtitle.en: readMetadata and writeImage now expose the Apple Maker Note as makerApple, whose key '17' holds the Live Photo asset identifier.
subtitle.zh: readMetadata 与 writeImage 现在支持 Apple Maker Note(makerApple),其中键 '17' 存放实况照片的 asset identifier。

subtitle.en: The new VideoEditor API opens the system video trimming interface. VideoEditor.present resolves with the trimmed video's file path, or null when the user cancels, with maximumDuration and quality to bound the result.
subtitle.zh: 新增 VideoEditor API,用于打开系统视频裁剪界面。VideoEditor.present 返回裁剪结果的文件路径,用户取消时返回 null,并可用 maximumDuration 与 quality 限定结果。

subtitle.en: Create iCloud-backed shared data stores and collaborate on them with other users.
subtitle.zh: 创建基于 iCloud 的共享数据源，并与其他用户协同维护。

subtitle.en: Present the system "Open in…" menu so the user can pick an app to open a file with.
subtitle.zh: 弹出系统“打开方式…”菜单，让用户选择一个 App 来打开文件。

subtitle.en: Add scrollToPosition, scrollSelectionIntoView, and getSelectedText methods.
subtitle.zh: 新增 scrollToPosition、scrollSelectionIntoView、getSelectedText 等方法。

subtitle.en: Send push notifications to your own devices from your servers and automations using an API key.
subtitle.zh: 使用 API key，从你自己的服务器和自动化流程向自己的设备发送推送通知。

subtitle.en: Create and play custom Core Haptics patterns with engines, events, parameters, players, and AHAP data.
subtitle.zh: 使用 engine、event、parameter、player 和 AHAP 数据创建并播放自定义 Core Haptics 触觉 pattern。

subtitle.en: Index script-defined items into system Spotlight and handle taps with spotlight.tsx through Spotlight.current.
subtitle.zh: 将脚本定义的资源加入系统 Spotlight，并通过 spotlight.tsx 与 Spotlight.current 处理点击。

subtitle.en: Add new PHAssetCollection, PHAsset APIs.
subtitle.zh: 新增 PHAssetCollection， PHAsset 等API。

subtitle.en: On-device language ID, tokenization, POS / NER / sentiment tagging, word & sentence embeddings, gazetteers, and contextual embeddings .
subtitle.zh: 端上语言识别、分词、词性 / 命名实体 / 情感标注、词与句嵌入、Gazetteer 自定义词典,以及上下文嵌入。

subtitle.en: Detect the dominant language or rank candidates by confidence.
subtitle.zh: 检测主语言或按置信度排序候选语言。

subtitle.en: Split text into words, sentences, paragraphs, or documents.
subtitle.zh: 按 word / sentence / paragraph / document 切分文本。

subtitle.en: Part-of-speech, lemma, named-entity, sentiment, custom tags from gazetteers.
subtitle.zh: 词性、词元、命名实体、情感打分,以及来自 Gazetteer 的自定义标签。

subtitle.en: Built-in word and sentence vectors for similarity, neighbors, distance.
subtitle.zh: 内置词向量与句向量,用于相似度、邻居与距离计算。

subtitle.en: User-supplied lexicon that overrides the system tagger for custom vocabularies.
subtitle.zh: 用户提供的自定义词典,用于覆盖系统模型的标注结果。

subtitle.en: Transformer-style sequence embeddings.
subtitle.zh: transformer 风格的序列嵌入。

subtitle.en: Run userscripts in Safari, use GM APIs, and access Scripting.FileManager.
subtitle.zh: 在 Safari 中运行用户脚本，使用 GM API，并访问 Scripting.FileManager。

subtitle.en: Type a trigger word in Safari's address bar to jump to a site's search.
subtitle.zh: 在 Safari 地址栏输入触发词，直接跳转到站点搜索。

subtitle.en: Rewrite matching URLs in Safari and redirect to another address.
subtitle.zh: 在 Safari 中改写匹配的 URL 并重定向到另一个地址。

subtitle.en: Assemble your own capture pipeline (device + input + photo / movie / metadata outputs), select AVCaptureDeviceFormat by resolution / fps / HDR / spatial video, switch color space and clamp frame rate, capture Live Photo with paired .mov, opt into responsive capture / fast prioritization / ZSL / deferred photo, drive iPhone 16 hardware Camera Control with custom sliders & pickers, and render previews with <CaptureVideoPreviewView/>.
subtitle.zh: 自己组装相机流水线（设备 + 输入 + 拍照 / 录像 / metadata 输出）;按分辨率 / 帧率 / HDR / spatial video 挑 AVCaptureDeviceFormat,切换色彩空间、锁帧率上下限;拍 Live Photo 同时拿静态图和配对 .mov;开启 responsive capture / fast prioritization / ZSL / deferred photo;用自定义滑块 / 选择器驱动 iPhone 16 硬件 Camera Control;并用 <CaptureVideoPreviewView/> 渲染实时预览。

subtitle.en: Build a session, scan QR codes, capture photos, render the preview, and tear it down. Self-contained demo.
subtitle.zh: 搭建 session、扫 QR、拍照、渲染预览、清理释放,完整 demo。

subtitle.en: AVCaptureSlider, AVCaptureIndexPicker, system zoom / exposure sliders, and AVCaptureEventInteraction for the iPhone 16 hardware button.
subtitle.zh: AVCaptureSlider、AVCaptureIndexPicker、系统缩放/曝光滑块,以及让 iPhone 16 硬件按键拍照的 AVCaptureEventInteraction。

title.zh: 点击对焦 / 中断事件 / 视频稳定化

subtitle.en: Three small but common controls: focus / exposure point of interest, session interruption notifications, and movie stabilization mode.
subtitle.zh: 三个常用控制点:焦点曝光点击对焦、会话中断通知、录像视频稳定化模式。

subtitle.en: Zero Shutter Lag, Responsive Capture, Fast Prioritization, and Auto Deferred Photo Delivery — what each does and when (not) to enable it.
subtitle.zh: Zero Shutter Lag、Responsive Capture、Fast Prioritization、Auto Deferred Photo Delivery 四个开关讲清楚,以及什么时候不该开。

subtitle.en: Pass `livePhotoMovieFile` to capturePhoto and resolve with both the still image and the .mov companion clip.
subtitle.zh: 在 capturePhoto 时传 livePhotoMovieFile,resolve 同时拿到静态图和 .mov 短片。

subtitle.en: List and switch AVCaptureDeviceFormat (resolution, fps, HDR, multi-cam, spatial video, stabilization); pick a color space via setActiveColorSpace; lock frame-rate ceiling/floor via setActiveVideoMin/MaxFrameDuration.
subtitle.zh: 列出并切换 AVCaptureDeviceFormat(分辨率、帧率、HDR、multi-cam、spatial video、稳定化);setActiveColorSpace 切色彩空间;setActiveVideoMin/MaxFrameDuration 锁帧率上下限。

subtitle.en: Render the live preview of any AVCaptureSession in a SwiftUI view with rotation coordination.
subtitle.zh: 用 SwiftUI 视图渲染任意 AVCaptureSession 的实时预览,支持旋转协调。

subtitle.en: When to reach for the high-level VideoRecorder vs the low-level AVCaptureSession pipeline.
subtitle.zh: 高层封装的 VideoRecorder 与底层的 AVCaptureSession 流水线,各自适合什么场景。

subtitle.en: This interface is used to call Github API.
subtitle.zh: 用于调用Github API的接口。

subtitle.en: Real-time microphone capture exposing raw PCM frames, RMS / peak levels, and YIN-based pitch estimates. Suitable for tuners, waveform views, and custom DSP. Optionally writes a wav file.
subtitle.zh: 基于 AVAudioEngine 的实时音频采集接口，向脚本输出原始 PCM 数据、电平（RMS / Peak）以及基于 YIN 算法的音高估计，适合调音器、实时波形与自定义 DSP，可选择落盘为 wav 文件。

subtitle.en: Added level metering: meteringEnabled / averagePower / peakPower / onLevelUpdate. Drive a VU meter or loudness-based triggers while recording, without exposing raw PCM samples.
subtitle.zh: 新增电平测量能力：meteringEnabled / averagePower / peakPower / onLevelUpdate，可在录音过程中驱动 VU 表或基于响度做触发逻辑，不暴露原始 PCM 数据。

subtitle.en: Added isSSML option to Speech.speak / Speech.synthesizeToFile for SSML input on iOS 16+.
subtitle.zh: Speech.speak / Speech.synthesizeToFile 新增 isSSML 选项,在 iOS 16+ 支持 SSML 输入。

subtitle.en: Recognition results expose more fields, and start() accepts a new preferredInput option to force the built-in microphone.
subtitle.zh: 识别结果新增更多字段；start() 新增 preferredInput 选项，可强制使用内置麦克风。

subtitle.en: New audio routing APIs: list available inputs, set the preferred input (e.g. force builtInMic), override the output port, observe route changes, plus an in-process "prefer built-in mic" switch for clean input/output separation when wireless headphones are connected.
subtitle.zh: 新增音频路由相关 API：列出可用输入、设置首选输入（例如强制 builtInMic）、强制输出端口、监听路由变化，以及进程内"优先内置麦克风"开关，便于在连接无线耳机时分离输入/输出。

subtitle.en: Add options parameter to setSource method, to configure request headers.
subtitle.zh: setSource 方法新增 options 可选参数，可配置请求 headers。

subtitle.en: A handle to a media asset for loading metadata / tracks and extracting still frames without an AVPlayer.
subtitle.zh: 媒体资源句柄:不启动 AVPlayer 即可加载元数据 / 轨道并提取静帧。

title.zh: AVAsset 读取 / 写入 / 导出

subtitle.en: Low-level media pipelines: export-session transcode, frame-level read, and frame / sample write to mp4 / m4a.
subtitle.zh: 低层媒体管线:export 转码、帧级读取,以及向 mp4 / m4a 写帧 / 采样。

subtitle.en: Read / write image metadata (EXIF / GPS / TIFF / IPTC) and encode formats UIImage can't (HEIC / TIFF / GIF).
subtitle.zh: 读写图片元数据(EXIF / GPS / TIFF / IPTC),并编码 UIImage 产不出的格式(HEIC / TIFF / GIF)。

subtitle.en: Heading stream APIs (requestHeading / startUpdatingHeading / addHeadingListener / removeHeadingListener), continuous location stream APIs (startUpdatingLocation / stopUpdatingLocation / addLocationListener / removeLocationListener), an optional requestAlwaysAuthorization flag on startUpdating*, CLLocationManager passthrough properties (allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates / pausesLocationUpdatesAutomatically / showsBackgroundLocationIndicator / distanceFilter / headingFilter / activityType), and the streaming Promise now resolves with the authorization mode actually granted.
subtitle.zh: 新增航向流接口（requestHeading / startUpdatingHeading / addHeadingListener / removeHeadingListener）、持续位置流接口（startUpdatingLocation / stopUpdatingLocation / addLocationListener / removeLocationListener）、startUpdating* 可选 requestAlwaysAuthorization 选项、CLLocationManager 透传属性（allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates / pausesLocationUpdatesAutomatically / showsBackgroundLocationIndicator / distanceFilter / headingFilter / activityType），且流式 Promise 现已返回实际获得的授权模式。

subtitle.en: NowPlayingInfo gains an isLiveStream flag; when true the Lock Screen and Control Center hide the progress bar and render as a live broadcast.
subtitle.zh: NowPlayingInfo 新增 isLiveStream 字段;设为 true 时锁屏与控制中心隐藏进度条,按直播 UI 渲染。

subtitle.en: Run shell commands from JS / TS via the embedded ios_system runtime, with support for cwd, timeout, env, and queryParameters.
subtitle.zh: 通过内嵌 ios_system 运行时在 JS / TS 中执行 shell 命令,支持 cwd、timeout、env 与 queryParameters。

subtitle.en: Run Python code snippets from JS / TS via the embedded Python interpreter; shares a serial queue with Shell.run.
subtitle.zh: 通过内嵌 Python 解释器在 JS / TS 中运行 Python 代码片段;与 Shell.run 共享同一串行队列。

subtitle.en: ChartGesture (custom gestures + ChartProxy.select* for programmatic selection), ChartPlotStyle (plot-area background / border / frame builder), ChartAxisLabelFormat (currency / number / date precision factories), and per-mark VoiceOver fields (accessibilityLabel / Value / Hidden).
subtitle.zh: ChartGesture（自定义手势 + ChartProxy.select* 程式化驱动选区）、ChartPlotStyle（plot 区域 background / border / frame builder）、ChartAxisLabelFormat（货币 / 数字 / 日期精度工厂），以及每个 mark 的 VoiceOver 字段（accessibilityLabel / Value / Hidden）。

subtitle.en: chartScrollTargetBehavior(.valueAligned) snaps chart scroll deceleration to data boundaries. Pick unit step for numeric axes or matching DateComponents for date axes; majorAlignment controls the secondary 'page' snap.
subtitle.zh: chartScrollTargetBehavior(.valueAligned) 让图表滚动减速时停在数据边界上。数值轴用 unit 步进、日期轴用 matching DateComponents，majorAlignment 控制次级 page 对齐。

subtitle.en: chartLegend accepts a Visibility string ("automatic" / "visible" / "hidden") to keep or remove the auto-generated legend, or an object ({ position, alignment?, spacing?, content? }) to reposition or fully customize it.
subtitle.zh: chartLegend 支持传入 Visibility 字符串（"automatic" / "visible" / "hidden"）保留或移除自动图例，也支持传入对象（{ position, alignment?, spacing?, content? }）重新定位或完全自定义图例。

subtitle.en: iOS 18+ LinePlot / AreaPlot mark types — plot smooth curves and areas straight from a JS function. Supports single-variable y=f(x), parametric (x,y)=f(t), and AreaPlot (yStart,yEnd)=f(x).
subtitle.zh: iOS 18+ 新增 LinePlot / AreaPlot mark：用一个 JS 函数直接画平滑曲线 / 区间面积。支持单变量 y=f(x)、参数化 (x,y)=f(t)、AreaPlot (yStart,yEnd)=f(x)。

title.zh: ScrollView：滚动位置与可见性跟踪

subtitle.en: scrollPosition(id:anchor:) two-way binds the leading visible item's id to JS state on plain ScrollView (no ScrollViewReader needed). onScrollTargetVisibilityChange (iOS 18+) reports the full visible-id set as you scroll. Children mark themselves with key={...} (mapped to SwiftUI .id()) and the layout container needs scrollTargetLayout.
subtitle.zh: scrollPosition(id:anchor:) 把普通 ScrollView 中 leading 可见 item 的 id 双向绑定到 JS state，不需要 ScrollViewReader 包一层。onScrollTargetVisibilityChange（iOS 18+）回调当前可见 id 集合。子节点用 key={...} 标 id（bridge 映射到 SwiftUI .id()），布局容器开 scrollTargetLayout。

subtitle.en: iOS 26 / SF Symbols 7 introduces drawOn and drawOff symbol animations. The bridge now exposes them via the `isActive` trigger form (mirrors SwiftUI symbolEffect(_:options:isActive:)) — flip a bool to draw the symbol on or off. The new SymbolEffectOptions (speed / repeat / nonRepeating) is also wired through, and isActive is opened up for the existing appear / disappear / scale effects. Silent fallback on iOS < 26 for drawOn/drawOff.
subtitle.zh: iOS 26 / SF Symbols 7 新增了 drawOn 与 drawOff 动画。桥层通过 `isActive` 触发形态透出（对应 SwiftUI symbolEffect(_:options:isActive:)）——翻转一个 bool 即可让符号画上或擦除。同时打通了 SymbolEffectOptions（speed / repeat / nonRepeating），现有的 appear / disappear / scale 也开放了 isActive 形态。drawOn/drawOff 在 iOS 26 以下静默透传。

subtitle.en: A SwiftUI-backed view with a Web-Canvas-style imperative 2D drawing API.
subtitle.zh: 基于 SwiftUI 的视图,提供与 Web Canvas 一致的命令式 2D 绘图 API。

subtitle.en: A SwiftUI-`Path`-style vector path you build, render with `<PathShape>`, query, or use as a clip shape.
subtitle.zh: 对齐 SwiftUI `Path` 的矢量路径:可构建、用 `<PathShape>` 渲染、查询几何,或当作 clip 形状。

subtitle.en: SwiftUI MapKit support: a `<Map>` view plus `MapSearch` / `MapUtils` / `MapDirections` / `MapSnapshotter` / `MapLookAround` namespaces.
subtitle.zh: SwiftUI MapKit 支持:`<Map>` 视图,以及 `MapSearch` / `MapUtils` / `MapDirections` / `MapSnapshotter` / `MapLookAround` 命名空间。

subtitle.en: A SwiftUI MapKit view with camera binding, map styles, `MapContent` children, controls, and selection detail cards.
subtitle.zh: SwiftUI MapKit 视图:相机绑定、地图样式、`MapContent` 子组件、内置控件与选中 detail 卡。

subtitle.en: Convert between map coordinates and points using native projection, including rotated and pitched maps.
subtitle.zh: 使用原生投影转换地图经纬度与视图中的点，支持旋转与倾斜地图。

subtitle.en: MapKit keyword search: one-shot `locate(...)` and stateful autocomplete via `createCompleter(...)`.
subtitle.zh: MapKit 关键字搜索:一次性 `locate(...)` 与状态化自动补全 `createCompleter(...)`。

subtitle.en: Synchronous MapKit geometry helpers: `distance`, `bearing`, `regionContains`, `regionFromCoordinates`.
subtitle.zh: 同步的 MapKit 几何工具:`distance`、`bearing`、`regionContains`、`regionFromCoordinates`。

subtitle.en: MapKit route planning: `calculate(...)` for full routes and `calculateETA(...)` for travel time only.
subtitle.zh: MapKit 路线规划:`calculate(...)` 取完整路线,`calculateETA(...)` 只取耗时 / 距离。

subtitle.en: Render a static map image offscreen with `take(...)`, including coordinate-to-point projection.
subtitle.zh: 用 `take(...)` 离屏渲染静态地图图片,并支持坐标到像素的投影。

subtitle.en: MapKit LookAround street-level scenes via `request(...)`, rendered with `<LookAroundPreview>`.
subtitle.zh: MapKit LookAround 街景:`request(...)` 获取场景,用 `<LookAroundPreview>` 渲染。

subtitle.en: `<Annotation>` anchors a custom SwiftUI view at a map coordinate, beyond the stock `<Marker>` glyph.
subtitle.zh: `<Annotation>` 把自定义 SwiftUI 视图锚定到地图坐标,突破原生 `<Marker>` 样式限制。

subtitle.en: Python index scripts can now read Script.name / queryParameters / metadata / directory and call Script.run / Script.exit, mirroring the JS-side Script global.
subtitle.zh: Python 索引脚本现可读取 Script.name / queryParameters / metadata / directory,并调用 Script.run / Script.exit,与 JS 端 Script 全局对象语义一致。

subtitle.en: Python-side persistent key-value storage with per-script and shared namespaces, sharing the underlying store with the JS-side Storage namespace.
subtitle.zh: Python 端的持久化键值存储,与 JS 端 Storage 共享同一底层存储,支持按脚本隔离与跨脚本共享。

subtitle.en: Python-side read-only device info: model, system version, screen, battery, orientation, and locale.
subtitle.zh: Python 端只读获取设备信息:型号、系统版本、屏幕、电池、方向、语言等。

subtitle.en: Python-side synchronous Dialog API: alert / confirm / prompt / actionSheet wrappers around the host's modal UI.
subtitle.zh: Python 端同步对话框 API:封装宿主模态 UI,提供 alert / confirm / prompt / actionSheet。

subtitle.en: Added a programmable Chinese input-method engine: load schemas, feed key events, render candidates, and commit text from JavaScript in both the main app and the keyboard extension.
subtitle.zh: 新增可编程中文输入法引擎:在主 App 和键盘扩展内通过 JavaScript 加载方案、喂入按键事件、自绘候选条并提交文本。

subtitle.en: Keyboard scripts can list available keyboard scripts and switch directly with CustomKeyboard.allScripts, switchToScript(scriptName, queryParameters?), and nextScript(queryParameters?).
subtitle.zh: 键盘脚本现在可通过 CustomKeyboard.allScripts、switchToScript(scriptName, queryParameters?) 和 nextScript(queryParameters?) 列出并直接切换可用键盘脚本。

subtitle.en: This interface allows scripts to take control of the system translation panel’s UI and interaction flow.
subtitle.zh: 用于接管系统翻译面板的界面展示与交互流程，让脚本自定义翻译 UI，并实现自己的默认翻译逻辑。

subtitle.en: Create AlarmKit alarms and customize their Live Activity UI.
subtitle.zh: 创建 AlarmKit 闹钟，并自定义它们的 Live Activity UI。

subtitle.en: For creating and managing AlarmKit-based alarms, timers, and countdown reminders.
subtitle.zh: 为创建和管理基于 AlarmKit 的闹钟、定时器和倒计时提醒。

subtitle.en: Register a custom Lock Screen and Dynamic Island UI for AlarmKit alarms.
subtitle.zh: 为 AlarmKit 闹钟注册自定义锁屏和灵动岛 UI。

subtitle.en: Add webDAVDocumentsDirectory and isWebDAVAvailable properties.
subtitle.zh: 新增 webDAVDocumentsDirectory 和 isWebDAVAvailable 属性。

subtitle.en: These APIs allow a script running on iPhone to hide its UI without terminating the script instance, and to listen for resume or re-trigger events while the instance remains alive.
subtitle.zh: 用于在 iPhone 端支持“UI 可收起但脚本实例不终止”的运行模式，以及在脚本实例存活期间对恢复与再次触发行为进行监听。

title.zh: 可交互 UI 的 Assistant Tool

subtitle.zh: 学习如何通过 registerUIView 实现可交互工具 UI，并返回结构化输出。
subtitle.en: Learn how to build interactive Assistant Tools using registerUIView and return structured output.
Read local media library metadata, including songs, albums, artists, playlists, and artwork.
subtitle.zh: 读取本地媒体库元数据，包括歌曲、专辑、艺术家、播放列表与封面图。

subtitle.en: Control the system music player.
subtitle.zh: 控制系统音乐播放器。

subtitle.en: Extract data from web pages.
subtitle.zh: 从网页中提取数据。

subtitle.en: Added Reminder.get method to get a specific Reminder by ID.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Reminder.get 方法获取指定 ID 的提醒事项。

subtitle.en: Added CalendarEvent.get method to get a specific CalendarEvent by ID.
subtitle.zh: 新增 CalendarEvent.get 方法获取指定 ID 的日历事件。

subtitle.en: Added textContentType modifier for TextField to provide semantic input hints and autofill behavior.
subtitle.zh: 为 TextField 新增 textContentType 修饰符，用于提供语义化输入提示与自动填充能力。

subtitle.en: Added synchronous JWT APIs for signing, verifying, and decoding tokens, with support for HS/RS/PS/ES/EdDSA algorithms and standard claim validation.
subtitle.zh: 新增同步 JWT 接口，支持签发、验签与解码，并覆盖 HS/RS/PS/ES/EdDSA 算法及标准声明校验。

subtitle.en: Stream attitude, rotation rate, user acceleration, gravity, and connection events from spatial-audio headphones (AirPods Pro / Max / 3) on iOS 14+.
subtitle.zh: 在 iOS 14+ 上读取支持空间音频的耳机（AirPods Pro / Max / 3）的姿态、旋转速率、用户加速度、重力，以及连接/断开事件。

subtitle.en: It allows scripts to perform on-device AI tasks such as text generation, structured JSON output, and streaming responses.
subtitle.zh: 用于调用 iOS Foundation Models 执行文本生成、结构化输出、流式响应等任务。

subtitle.en: Added StyledText.paragraphStyle property.
subtitle.zh: 新增 StyledText.paragraphStyle 属性。

subtitle.en: New Intent.view method for returning custom UI to Shortcuts.
subtitle.zh: 新增 Intent.view 方法，用于在 Shortcuts 中返回并展示自定义UI。

subtitle.en: Adjusted Reminder.calendar property, which may be null if the user's device has not set a default calendar for reminders. It is recommended to specify a calendar when creating a Reminder instance.
subtitle.zh: 调整了Reminder.calendar属性，在通过new Reminder创建实例时该值可能因为用户的设备没有为Reminder设置默认日历而为空，建议在创建时指定日历。

subtitle.en: Added sliderThumbVisibility property.
subtitle.zh: 新增sliderThumbVisibility属性，用于控制滑块的显示状态。

subtitle.en: Create widgets to show your script’s content on the Home screen.
subtitle.zh: 创建小组件，在主屏幕上显示脚本内容。

subtitle.en: Quickly master the use of widget.

subtitle.zh: 一个执行递增和递减操作的控件。

subtitle.zh: 一个在设定范围内选择数值的控件。

subtitle.zh: 一个显示任务完成进度的视图。

subtitle.zh: 当应用的内容对用户不可用时，用于显示标签和其他内容的界面。

subtitle.zh: 这个视图可以用来打开网页、应用特定的URL或其他协议。

subtitle.zh: 浏览、预览、导入、导出、重命名和删除本地目录中的文件。

subtitle.en: Draw shapes like circles and rectangles, as well as custom paths that define shapes of your own design.
subtitle.zh: 绘制圆形、矩形等形状，并可使用自定义路径来定义自己设计的形状。

subtitle.zh: 它是用于创建逐步缩进（浓缩）角几何形状的矩形，适合现代 UI 设计。

subtitle.zh: 使用列表显示一维的垂直视图集合。

subtitle.zh: 一个根据展开控制状态来显示或隐藏其他内容视图的视图。

subtitle.zh: 为列表中的行添加自定义滑动操作。

subtitle.en: A container for grouping controls used for data entry, such as in settings or inspectors.
subtitle.zh: 一个用于分组输入控件的容器，可用于设置或检查器等场景。

subtitle.en: A container view that displays semantically-related controls in a visually-appropriate manner for the context.
subtitle.zh: 一个在语义相关的上下文中，以合适的视觉方式显示控件的容器视图。

subtitle.en: Enable people to scroll to content that doesn’t fit in the current display.
subtitle.zh: 允许用户滚动查看当前显示区域无法容纳的内容。

subtitle.en: This interface provides a gesture system similar to SwiftUI, allowing any view to respond to touch interactions such as tapping, long pressing, dragging, rotating, and magnifying.
subtitle.zh: 该接口提供了类似于 SwiftUI 的手势系统，允许任何视图响应触摸交互，如轻点、长按、拖拽、旋转和放大。

subtitle.en: This view is used to create and manage a geometry animation namespace.
subtitle.zh: 该视图用于创建和管理几何动画命名空间。

subtitle.en: Enable people to move between different parts of your script’s view hierarchy within a scene.
subtitle.zh: 允许用户在脚本的视图层级中各个部分之间进行导航。

subtitle.en: A view that displays a root view and enables you to present additional views over the root view.
subtitle.zh: 一个显示根视图并允许在根视图上呈现其他视图的视图。

subtitle.zh: 允许使用绑定的可观察数组直接操作导航历史。

subtitle.en: An view that displays interactive web content.
subtitle.zh: 一个用于显示交互式网页内容的视图。

subtitle.zh: 该接口提供了一些用于显示对话框的快捷方法。

subtitle.zh: Python 索引脚本可用的 Dialog API,与 JS 端语义一致:同步阻塞封装宿主 UI,提供 alert / confirm / prompt / actionSheet。

subtitle.en: Present content in a separate view that offers focused interaction.
subtitle.zh: 在单独的视图中呈现内容，以提供更专注的交互。

subtitle.en: Provide immediate access to frequently used commands and controls.
subtitle.zh: 为用户提供快速访问常用命令和控件。

subtitle.en: Enable people to search for text or other content within your script UI.
subtitle.zh: 允许用户在脚本界面内搜索文本或其他内容。

subtitle.en: Allowing scripts to programmatically control scrolling position within scrollable content such as List or ScrollView.
subtitle.zh: 允许脚本在可滚动内容（例如 List 或 ScrollView）内控制滚动位置。

subtitle.en: Read container size, safe area, corner insets and frame snapshots in declared coordinate spaces.
subtitle.zh: 读取容器尺寸、安全区域、圆角内边距及指定坐标空间的 frame 布局快照。

subtitle.en: This view allows you to read environment values from the current view hierarchy.
subtitle.zh: 它允许脚本在视图层级中访问当前环境的上下文信息，例如颜色模式、尺寸类别、是否正在搜索、是否被呈现、编辑模式等。

subtitle.en: This component is designed to be used inside accessory widgets—such as Lock Screen widgets or StandBy widgets.
subtitle.zh: 适用于配件类小组件（Accessory Widgets），如锁屏小组件或待机模式（StandBy）小组件。

subtitle.en: Transform your data into informative visualizations.
subtitle.zh: 将您的数据转换为信息丰富的可视化图表。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as a series of points connected by straight lines.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为一系列点并通过直线连接的图表。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as rectangular bars with lengths proportional to the values they represent.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为矩形条形，其长度与所代表的值成比例的图表。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as rectangles, where the size and color of each rectangle represent different data values.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为矩形的图表，其中每个矩形的大小和颜色代表不同的数据值。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as a series of rules, which can be used to represent thresholds or limits.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为一系列标尺的图表，可用于表示阈值或限制。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as a series of points connected by lines, with categories on the a specified axis.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为一系列点并通过线连接的图表，其中一个轴上有指定的类别。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as stacked bars, where each bar represents a total and is divided into segments representing sub-values.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为堆叠条形的图表，其中每个条形代表总值，并被分割成表示子值的段。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as groups of bars, where each group represents a category and the bars within the group represent sub-categories.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为分组条形的图表，其中每个组代表一个类别，组内的条形代表子类别。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as stacked areas, where each area represents a total and is divided into segments representing sub-values.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为堆叠面积的图表，其中每个面积代表总值，并被分割成表示子值的段。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as horizontal bars, typically used to represent project schedules or timelines.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为水平条形的图表，通常用于表示项目进度或时间线。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as areas between two lines, representing a range of values.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为两条线之间的面积的图表，表示一系列值。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as a single-dimensional bar, typically used for representing a single value or category.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为一维条形的图表，通常用于表示单个值或类别。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as individual points, typically used for scatter plots or discrete data.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为单个点的图表，通常用于散点图或离散数据。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as points categorized by a specific axis, useful for visualizing discrete data with categories.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为按特定轴分类的点的图表，适用于可视化具有类别的离散数据。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as a matrix of colors, where each color represents a value in a two-dimensional space.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为颜色矩阵的图表，其中每种颜色代表二维空间中的一个值。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as rectangular areas, where the size and color of each rectangle represent different data values.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为矩形面积的图表，其中每个矩形的大小和颜色代表不同的数据值。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as slices of a pie, where each slice represents a proportion of the whole.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为饼图切片的图表，其中每个切片代表整体的一部分。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as a donut shape, similar to a pie chart but with a hole in the center.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为环形的图表，类似于饼图，但中间有一个空心部分。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as a series of lines, with rules indicating specific values or thresholds.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为一系列线条的图表，规则指示特定值或阈值。

subtitle.en: A chart that displays data as a series of lines, with labels indicating specific values or thresholds.
subtitle.zh: 一个将数据表示为一系列线条的图表，标签指示特定值或阈值。

subtitle.zh: 一个演示如何在单个视图中使用多个图表的示例。

subtitle.zh: 通过 chartXAxis / chartYAxis 配合 AxisMarksConfig 自定义网格线、刻度、标签格式与步长。

subtitle.zh: 使用 ChartOverlay + ChartProxy 自定义 tooltip 与 hit-test；通过 chartXSelection / chartYSelection 的 from/to 形式做拖选区间。

subtitle.zh: 通过 chartScrollTargetBehavior 让图表滚动停留时按数据边界对齐：数值轴用 unit 步进，日期轴用 matching DateComponents。

subtitle.zh: 用一个 JS 函数直接画平滑曲线 / 面积。支持单变量 y=f(x)、参数化 (x,y)=f(t)、AreaPlot (yStart,yEnd)=f(x)。iOS 18+。

subtitle.en: A view that renders Markdown content, allowing you to display formatted text, links, images, and more.
subtitle.zh: 一个渲染 Markdown 内容的视图，允许您显示格式化文本、链接、图片等。

subtitle.zh: 一个提供富文本编辑界面的视图。

subtitle.zh: Color API 支持多种颜色格式，包括 HEX 字符串、RGBA 字符串以及预定义的颜色关键字。

subtitle.zh: 该类型定义了如何将颜色、渐变和材质应用于视图的前景或背景，类似于 SwiftUI 中的样式功能。
